column3: “Portion” resolves the image of his hand.
Gushing and pouring give a flowing sense to the repeated keeping fresh or cool.
The thorough gleaning is made a command instead of a predicted action.
“Closed” replaces the image of an uncircumcised ear.
“Congregations” is plural instead of singular; future events explain what is among them.
“Men in formation” resolves the singular man of battle.
“Ore” supplies the object of testing, while the fortress is not separately expressed.
